matching_phases.description: Join using ISRC (recordings) or ISWC (works). Highest precision, automatic acceptance.
Join normalized title_base + primary_artist using strict blocking (avoid cartesian explosion).
Secondary join rule when audio data includes duration; ensures timing-based validation.
RapidFuzz-based partial ratio above 90%; requires manual review before approval.

relations_table.format: Parquet or CSV (max 50k rows per file)

coverage_report.frequency: Run twice: now (sample) and after ingesting full historical batch

review_queue.goal: Generate small CSV (≤200 lines) of ambiguous matches
